learning.sceneConnection: 取舍是两个目标间的决策关系，天平只作情境道具。
learning.association: 取舍是两个目标间的决策关系，天平只作情境道具。
learning.collocation: explain a trade-off; a security trade-off
learning.example:
A: Explain the trade-off between security and performance.
B: Stronger checks improve security but add work to every request.
A: Use this balance scale to compare both costs clearly.
B: I'll describe the performance cost and when the security benefit matters.
learning.exampleChinese:
A: 解释一下安全性与性能之间的取舍。
B: 更严格的检查会提升安全性，但也会增加每个请求的处理工作。
A: 用这架天平把两边的代价比较清楚。
B: 我会说明性能代价，以及安全收益在什么情况下重要。
